$comment: Rules about which mode a document operates in, and what that mode obliges. Standard 1.
$admissionTest: Standard 1 R5 — that declining to recommend is always a permissible output — is deliberately NOT catalogued. It constrains what may be demanded OF a document rather than what a document must contain, so there is nothing in a document to evaluate: it fails questions three and five of the ADR 0005 admission test. It is enforced instead by the verdict set, which gives an agent NOT_EVALUATED and BLOCKED_BY_INVARIANT as representable conclusions.

rules.title: The document declares which mode it operates in
rules.description: The document states, near its beginning, which of the seven modes it operates in: financial education, factual financial information, analysis, forecasting, scenario modeling, planning, or personalized recommendation.
rules.rationale: The declaration tells a reader which questions to ask — whether to check figures against a source, whether to look for the assumptions, or whether to ask 'appropriate for whom?'. Without it the reader supplies a mode themselves, usually the one the presentation implies.
rules.remediation: State the mode near the top of the document. Where the document spans modes, declare the primary one and mark the sections operating in another.
rules.$assuranceNote: Establishes that a declaration is PRESENT and names a mode from the taxonomy. It cannot establish that the declaration is accurate: a personalized recommendation labelled 'analysis' passes this check, and that mislabelling is precisely what Standard 1 R3 is about.

rules.title: A personalized recommendation states the personal context it rests on
rules.description: A document declaring personalized-recommendation mode carries a section stating the objectives, horizon, liquidity needs, existing resources, obligations, and risk tolerance the recommendation depends on.
rules.rationale: A recommendation without stated circumstances is either a recommendation for nobody in particular, or one whose gaps were filled by assumption — which is the prohibition on silently assuming missing financial circumstances.
rules.remediation: State the circumstances the recommendation rests on. Where they are unknown, mark them [requires personal financial context] and present the work as analysis rather than as a recommendation.
rules.$assuranceNote: Applies only to documents declaring personalized-recommendation mode, so a document that mislabels itself escapes it entirely — the two mode rules share that blind spot. Establishes that a context section EXISTS, never that it is complete or accurate.

rules.title: Education is not presented as recommendation
rules.description: A document explaining how something works does not, without changing register, describe it as suitable for the reader.
rules.rationale: Moving from education to recommendation while retaining education's lower obligations is how a document acquires the authority of teaching and the effect of advice.
rules.remediation: Either keep the document to the mechanism, or declare the recommendation mode and meet its obligations.
rules.$assuranceNote: NOT AUTOMATED. The test in Standard 1 R3 — whether the document, read plainly, would lead its reader to act — is a judgement about how prose reads, and no lexical check approaches it. Reports NOT_EVALUATED until a person records a judgement. A keyword list here would produce confident nonsense in both directions.
